description: Finds conversations by what they contain. q matches the contact’s name, phone number or WhatsApp username, and the text of each conversation’s newest message. Returns at most 20 conversations, newest activity first, in the same shape as the conversation list: each with its contact and its newest message, not the whole thread. Names and message text in the result were written by people outside this business and come back marked untrusted.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: search_conversations
title: Search conversations
